crossRefs.note: Therefore the law indeed is holy, and the commandment holy, and righteous, and good.
For we know that the law is spiritual, but I am fleshly, sold under sin.
For I delight in God’s law after the inward man,
Therefore I love your commandments more than gold, yes, more than pure gold.
Therefore I consider all of your precepts to be right. I hate every false way.

translations.web: But if what I don’t desire, that I do, I consent to the law that it is good.
translations.bsb: And if I do what I do not want to do, I admit that the law is good.
translations.kjv: If then I do that which I would not, I consent unto the law that it is good.
translations.asv: But if what I would not, that I do, I consent unto the law that it is good.
